identity: Neutral molecular nitric acid HONO2, CAS 7697-37-2, planar singlet X1A-prime gas species with internal OH torsion; not nitrate ion, aqueous acid, liquid acid or HONO.
recommendation: Retain the present Dorofeeva 2003-based curated fit. The actual adopted source has been inspected and reproduced; no scientifically compelling full replacement is established by comparison with the older JANAF web table or finite-range opacity partition data.
science: The current fit cites Dorofeeva 2003, not the older JANAF 1998 web table. Table 1 of the actual paper gives a molecular torsional evaluation that the inherited fit reproduces within 1.84% at the four hot nodes when balanced against JANAF atoms. The approximately 20% difference from the old web table is therefore an intended source distinction. ATcT changes this actual-source atomization energy by only -0.200 kJ/mol, within the paper formation-enthalpy uncertainty 0.5 kJ/mol. This is a source-based reason to retain, not merely a trace-abundance argument.
modern: Dorofeeva et al. 2003 was inspected in full and four hot table nodes plus its 0/298 K anchors were transcribed. The work treats internal torsion, omits electronic states above 30000 cm-1 and states caloric uncertainty estimates. TIPS 2025 principal-isotope Q/NASA is 0.9214 at 1500 K and 0.9207 at 3000 K, but its table ends at 3500 K and is not a demonstrated complete thermal improvement. ExoMol 2015 advertises line-list use only up to 500 K, so it cannot be promoted into a 1500-4000 K replacement from the abstract.
importance: Nitric acid is relevant to atmospheric nitrogen reservoirs and proposed spectral signatures in cooler planetary atmospheres. The present hot reducing grid does not test those photochemical or condensed/aqueous roles.
conventions: The accepted molecular source includes internal rotation; no extra conformer multiplier is imposed. TIPS 14N/1H nuclear-spin product 6 is removed once, with molecular symmetry already included. Use the same natural-mass translation for comparison. The true adopted-source energy update is distinct from the explicitly labelled JANAF-proxy energy diagnostic.
followup: No curated update is required by the available evidence. Optional future work may quantify the inherited fit residual or examine a complete modern torsional/rovibrational model above 3500 K. Any small ATcT energy sensitivity should use Dorofeeva physical energy and preserve the fit residual; do not substitute the older JANAF anchor.
